item.description:
Faster, more accurate speech

  • New speech engine (Parakeet Unified 0.6B): live preview while you talk, higher-accuracy batch decode when you stop. Roughly a quarter fewer errors overall, 80% fewer on short dictations.
  • Final text lands well under a second after you stop, even for multi-minute dictations.
  • Multi-line text is inserted in one operation instead of line by line.
  • Overlay shows a live word count, and the level meter is now a real frequency spectrum of your voice.
  • Agent mode ends sentences with proper punctuation, and an optional "Tidy false starts" setting removes abandoned thoughts spoken out loud (off by default; words are only ever deleted, never added).
  • The speech model download is now 1.16 GB; Natter asks once and removes the old model automatically.
